name: Platform verification and measurement
description:
Establish the platform facts that gate Caller Filter design. This feature owns focused probes and measured evidence, not completion of production applications.

COMPLETED FOUNDATION: P001/T001 and T002 remain done. T001 measured Call Directory on iPhone 13/iOS 26.6.1: 1.9M blocking entries loaded in 12.1s; 2M failed with MaximumEntriesExceeded (code 5). Identification alone loaded 1.9M in 47.58s. Combined blocking/identification budgets and variation across devices remain unverified. These are measurements, not compiled limits. Current internal-budget/backoff policy and recomputed country distribution belong to User-defined filtering, not older target counts. T002 verified Android SDK-36 screening, role and SMS restrictions; it did not perform physical-call acceptance.

COMPLETED PREPARATION: P014/T019–T021 is done. tools/device-tests/README.md and results-template.md define the consented missed-call baseline, ringing controls, repeated denies and recovery across screen/app states, with honest evidence statuses. The iPhone harness supports private exact/empty fixtures and real status/reload diagnostics while preserving capacity modes; unsigned empty and synthetic-exact arm64 Release builds and Swift/Python tests passed. The Android probe supplies actual role/fixture/status controls, declared screening service, Rust exact matching, redacted diagnostics and a verified development-signed APK. Neither preparation establishes real-call silence. Stop now for device connection and authorization before P017.

CODE STATE: iPhone tools/entry-limit-harness/App/App.swift:12, Shared/HarnessConfiguration.swift:59/:113, CallDir/CallDirectoryHandler.swift:22 and tools/device-tests/ios-probe.py:100/:143 cover the standalone probe, not the still-placeholder production CallDirectoryExtension. Android apps/android/app/src/main/java/com/antoniopantano/callerfilter/MainActivity.kt:17 and ScreeningService.kt:13/:33/:66 implement the diagnostic surface/service. ProbeEngine.kt:49/:63/:79 uses existing PreparedRules/evaluateNumber with one-response/deadline guards; ProbeStore.kt:32 serializes native work off the callback thread. Deny requests disallow/reject/missed-notification suppression; nonmatch/empty/error/deadline paths allow. No Kotlin matcher or new Rust API. tools/build-android.sh and tools/uniffi-android.toml regenerate three-ABI native libraries and JNA-cleaner bindings. JNA 5.17, ABI filtering, signature/manifest/permission checks and 16KB ZIP/ELF64 alignment were verified. tools/device-tests/android-probe.py:76/:116/:157 and android-probe.md separate builds from explicit-device installation/capture and document private input, role controls, recovery and cleanup.

LATEST ANDROID EVIDENCE: target/device-tests/android/ready-host-synthetic-asgtxqx5/caller-filter-probe.apk and sibling build record/logs. Actual Rust/JNA host tests and packaged-fixture checks passed; six final Python tooling/static-role/redaction-guard tests passed. assembleDebug and Lint passed (0 errors, 10 non-blocking prototype/dependency/legacy-backup warnings). Diagnostics distinguish response attempts from framework acknowledgement; the configured local timeout and local bind timestamp do not prove the full framework deadline. Synthetic host fixtures on either platform are not callable test numbers. No device installation, role/extension change or call was performed during preparation.

NEXT GATE: P017/T022 and T023 run physical Android/iPhone tests after connection, private consented caller fixtures, pairing/trust, iPhone signing/provisioning and platform enablement. Either phone may run first; the second completed physical task consolidates verdicts. Stop afterward for the user's go/no-go before further product/core feature work. Do not wait for AND/OR, Contains, national partial-input preparation, geography, OTA or production UI; those remain separate work.

ACCEPTANCE: a blocked call must not ring, vibrate, show incoming-call UI or generate blocked/missed-call notifications. Call-log records are allowed, and the app must generate no custom alert. Observe carrier-generated missed-call SMS separately; residual disturbance or ambiguous attribution cannot yield an unconditional pass. No voicemail settings are requested. Establish ordinary missed-call notification and ringing controls before/after removal, and record observation windows and any unobserved channels.

PLATFORM LIMITS: iOS Call Directory is an advance exact-number list with no call-time app callback, blocked-call history API or separate notification-suppression control. iPhone SMS filtering is a different live/Junk API outside these call probes. Android must answer within five seconds; contacts are exempt without READ_CONTACTS and withheld/unknown/unavailable/payphone calls never reach screening. setSkipNotification requests missed-call notification suppression; setSilenceCall alone is insufficient. setSkipCallLog is ignored for ordinary third-party apps, correcting older call-log-hiding claims. Android SMS remains outside release 1 because blocking requires default-messaging scope. BlockedNumberProvider is unavailable to ordinary screening apps, and CallScreeningService has no custom system caller label.

PRESERVE: prior capacity/SDK evidence and capacity/identification harness modes; Release/ENABLE_DEBUG_DYLIB=NO, correct extension properties and sorted/incremental-safe loading. Historical free-team signing is not a guarantee for the selected phone. App Groups or paid-team features must not become unnecessary prerequisites. Personal numbers, device IDs, generated bindings and binaries remain private/ignored. Android clearing deactivates deny but does not erase a fixture inside an APK. No automatic installation, unrelated settings changes, calls, history deletion, commit or push. Production integration must later repeat accepted physical cases.
workDone: P001 capacity/SDK verification preserved. P014 preparation completed: consented protocol, unsigned exact/empty iPhone host builds and controls, and a development-signed three-ABI Android APK using the existing Rust matcher. Applicable host, tooling, build, lint, packaging/privacy and documentation checks passed; evidence is recorded on T019–T021. No physical silent-blocking acceptance is claimed.
workRemaining: Await device connection and consent. In P017 run Android T022 and iPhone T023 in either order after pairing/trust, real private caller fixtures, iPhone provisioning and OS role/extension enablement. Verify baseline, empty/deny/recovery and no-disturbance behavior, record timing/evidence gaps and carrier alerts. The second test consolidates both verdicts, then stop for the user's go/no-go. Production integration must repeat accepted cases.
dependsOn: P005 shared-core exact-number/UniFFI delivery is already available; host evidence is not physical-device evidence.
Physical execution requires the user-provided phones, authorization and consented caller line(s).
